title: Universal /ask + Self-Knowledge Grounding
summary: Make /ask answer ANY question — including questions about smackerel itself — by adding self_knowledge as a first-class, grounded, cited answer source. Self-knowledge is derived fresh-by-construction from the live product SSTs (scenarios, commands, recipes, curated docs), ingested as embedded artifacts under a dedicated smackerel_self namespace via the existing pipeline, and searched semantically via a new general embedding-backed namespace searcher (resolving the 064 SCOPE-06 deferral). The cite-back verifier + provenance gate are unchanged; BUG-061-009's honest refusal is the fallback. The tool_allowlist is the general seam for wiring any command/surface as an answer source.
motivation: Diagnosed in BUG-061-010: the bot cannot answer questions about itself because web_search resolves 'smackerel' to a Super Mario enemy, internal_retrieval has no ingested product docs, and the local LLM has no training data on a private product. Answering about smackerel is an essential skill for a personal second brain. Operator direction (2026-07-23): pick best option for long term, no shortcuts — pgvector system-knowledge namespace + ingest curated docs via the existing pipeline, semantic search.

Integration- and e2e-tagged tests were NOT re-executed this session. Unit-level Go commands used the host toolchain (go1.25.10) instead of ./smackerel.sh because the repo CLI lane was occupied.
openFindings: F-1 HIGH gaps/chaos — semantic_searcher.go:107-113 applies no relevance threshold and GraphArtifact (internal_retrieval.go:47-51) discards the cosine distance, so self_knowledge returns min(k,|namespace|) cited sources for ANY query. FR-8 / Acceptance Scenario 5 has no enforcement mechanism at the retrieval layer; tests/integration/openknowledge/semantic_searcher_test.go:89,115 codifies returning an orthogonal 'unrelated' artifact as correct.

F-2 MEDIUM gaps — FR-6 unimplemented. /help is fed selfknowledge.Derive(manifest) (cmd/core/wiring_assistant_facade.go:255 — scenarios+commands only) while self_knowledge searches Ingestor.Corpus() (ingestor.go:81-91 — Derive plus curated doc entries), so the corpora provably diverge. scope-06 is recorded done and the Corpus() comment at ingestor.go:79-81 falsely claims the surfaces are shared; Corpus() has exactly one non-test caller.

F-3 MEDIUM security — self_knowledge.go:112-116 concatenates the raw driver error, and agent/agent.go:845-854 serialises it into the LLM context and the persisted trace, exposing pgx connection identifiers. Same pattern pre-exists at internal_retrieval.go:126-131 (spec 064).

F-4 LOW latent harden — ingestor.go:135-142 uses content_hash <> ALL($2::text[]); an empty keepHashes is vacuously true and would delete the whole smackerel_self namespace. Not reachable today because assistant.SlashShortcuts (internal/assistant/shortcuts.go:41) is a non-empty compile-time map, so a defensive guard is missing rather than a live bug.
F-5 LOW simplify — SelfKnowledge.Execute (self_knowledge.go:91-141) and InternalRetrieval.Execute (internal_retrieval.go:107-157) duplicate ~50 lines, working against FR-7's general-seam intent.

F-6 LOW unverified stabilize — the ivfflat index (001_initial_schema.sql:72) plus a source_id filter makes ANN recall plan-dependent; EXPLAIN was not run, so this is static reasoning needing runtime confirmation.

Rewriting internal_retrieval to the new searcher (follow-on; this spec makes the general searcher available)
